runs.failure_point: It read the same candidates as the passing runs but counted two matters whose 18-month-plus terms were only proposed as qualifying.

first_error.why: Its reads at [48]-[57] and [84]-[90] showed that two matters' long non-competes were only proposals never executed, yet the answer counts them as qualifying, a loose reading of 'ran'.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the write review at [106] flagged mixing proposals with executed terms and the check review at [113] named both matters; the agent finished without changing them.

divergence: All three runs found and read the same candidate set, including the two qualifying matters and two matters whose long terms were only proposed. They split at Write the response: T0 and T2 counted only executed or operative terms and listed the proposal-only matters as near misses (pass); T1 counted those two as qualifying (over-inclusion). The critic differed: T1's write review flagged mixing proposals with executed terms and its check review named both matters, but the agent finished unchanged; T0's and T2's write reviews instead warned that the reading might be too narrow, and both kept it.
